==Description==
'''Baseplate-L''' was a baseplate with two portals on it, which were connected to each other by a small l-shaped path.

This map had the [[April fools 2025]] modifier, which broke enemy appearance and animations.

==Design & Path==
'''Baseplate-L''' was a fairly small and mostly empty 125 by 125 studs platform, known as a baseplate. It only contained two basic cliffs and a short l-shaped path.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Baseplate-L}}

==Strategy==
*The best placement spots on this map are between the path, so that your towers can cover most of it.
**Because of how little path there is, most towers with decent range should be able to cover most if not all of it.
